command: cooperbench run -n solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-shard1of2-saturation-low-nostepcounter -s flash-shard1of2 -a mini_swe_agent_v2 -m gemini/gemini-3.8-flash --agent-config configs/variants/saturation_low_nostepcounter.yaml --setting solo -c 2 --backend docker --dataset-dir logs/_shards/flash-shard1of2
agent_config:
# Variant config: 500-step saturation control without the per-turn step counter.
# 500 steps, compaction at 64K tokens, low thinking, $40 per-agent cost cap,
# and containers kept alive for 10 hours (same as saturation_low.yaml except step_counter is off).
# Pass via: AGENT_CONFIG=configs/variants/saturation_low_nostepcounter.yaml RUN_SUFFIX=saturation-low-nostepcounter tools/run.sh solo ...
agent:
  cost_limit: 40.0
  step_limit: 500
  compaction_token_trigger: 64000

environment:
  container_timeout: "10h"

model:
  model_kwargs:
    drop_params: true
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingLevel: low
      includeThoughts: true
